title: ConfigApplyResult
description: JSON-encoded into CommandResult.detail. Overall status is done when every outcome is applied|unsupported, failed otherwise.

outcomes.description: keys: policies.<key>, kiosk, location, …, hardware.<rule>, restrictions.<no_xxx>. Hardware outcomes give the reason: `unsupported: sdk-<N>` (needs Android API N), `unsupported: device` (the hardware cannot), `unsupported: platform` (this Android build does not let an admin set it), `unsupported: held` (another section keeps it blocked), `unsupported: unknown`, `failed: not-effective` (accepted but not in force)
